name: htmlparser2
description_en: The fast & forgiving HTML and XML parser
readme_excerpt: htmlparser2 The fast & forgiving HTML/XML parser. htmlparser2 is the fastest HTML parser, and takes some shortcuts to get there. If you need strict HTML spec compliance, have a look at parse5. Installation npm install htmlparser2 A live demo of htmlparser2 is available on AST Explorer.
